sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/bixbench')
import galaxy_execute_mcp_core as core

history_id='bbd44e69cb8906b5d46ac47b3edc613c'
hda_id='f9cad7b01a4721357e93e0eaf87dead0'

rscript = r'''
set.seed(1)
dat <- read.csv(\""'$(inputs.input.path)", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tidy_area <- dat[!dat$StrainNumber %in% c("1", "98"), , drop = FALSE]
parts <- strsplit(as.character(tidy_area$Ratio), ":", fixed = TRUE)
num <- as.numeric(sapply(parts, `[`, 1))
den <- as.numeric(sapply(parts, `[`, 2))
tidy_area$Frequency <- num / (num + den)

library(splines)
fit_quad <- lm(Area ~ poly(Frequency, 2, raw = TRUE), data = tidy_area)
fit_cubic <- lm(Area ~ poly(Frequency, 3, raw = TRUE), data = tidy_area)
fit_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(Frequency, df = 4), data = tidy_area)

seq_freq <- seq(min(tidy_area$Frequency), max(tidy_area$Frequency), length.out = 1000)
pred_quad <- predict(fit_quad, newdata = data.frame(Frequency = seq_freq), interval = "confidence")
pred_cubic <- predict(fit_cubic, newdata = data.frame(Frequency = seq_freq), interval = "confidence")
pred_spline <- predict(fit_spline, newdata = data.frame(Frequency = seq_freq), interval = "confidence")

idx_quad <- which.max(pred_quad[, "fit"])
idx_cubic <- which.max(pred_cubic[, "fit"])
idx_spline <- which.max(pred_spline[, "fit"])

models <- list(
  quadratic = list(fit = fit_quad, idx = idx_quad, pred = pred_quad),
  cubic = list(fit = fit_cubic, idx = idx_cubic, pred = pred_cubic),
  spline = list(fit = fit_spline, idx = idx_spline, pred = pred_spline)
)

out <- data.frame(
  model = names(models),
  optimal_frequency = sapply(models, function(z) seq_freq[z$idx]),
  max_predicted_area = sapply(models, function(z) z$pred[z$idx, "fit"]),
  r_squared = sapply(models, function(z) summary(z$fit)$r.squared),
  adj_r_squared = sapply(models, function(z) summary(z$fit)$adj.r.squared),
  f_statistic = sapply(models, function(z) summary(z$fit)$fstatistic[1]),
  f_p_value = sapply(models, function(z) {
    fs <- summary(z$fit)$fstatistic
    pf(fs[1], fs[2], fs[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
  }),
  row.names = NULL
)
best_row <- which.max(out$r_squared)
best_model <- out$model[best_row]
best_max <- out$max_predicted_area[best_row]
write.table(out, "result.tsv", sep = "'"\\t\", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
cat(\"BEST_MODEL\", best_model, \"BEST_MAX\", format(best_max, digits = 12), \"\\n\")
'''

{rscript}
RS
''').lstrip('\\n')

idx_quad <- which.max(pred_quad[, "fit"])
idx_cubic <- which.max(pred_cubic[, "fit"])
idx_spline <- which.max(pred_spline[, "fit"])

models <- list(

  cubic = list(fit = fit_cubic, idx = idx_cubic, pred = pred_cubic),
  spline = list(fit = fit_spline, idx = idx_spline, pred = pred_spline)
)

out <- data.frame(
  model = names(models),
  optimal_frequency = sapply(models, function(z) seq_freq[z$idx]),
  max_predicted_area = sapply(models, function(z) z$pred[z$idx, "fit"]),
  r_squared = sapply(models, function(z) summary(z$fit)$r.squared),
  adj_r_squared = sapply(models, function(z) summary(z$fit)$adj.r.squared),
  f_statistic = sapply(models, function(z) summary(z$fit)$fstatistic[1]),
  f_p_value = sapply(models, function(z) {
    fs <- summary(z$fit)$fstatistic
    pf(fs[1], fs[2], fs[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
  }),
  row.names = NULL
)
best_row <- which.max(out$r_squared)
